frozen_source_oracle.detail: The rewritten analyzer matched the source experiment implementation exactly on peak value/CI, primary slope/CI, and accuracy using an independent synthetic 20-draw item-by-concept bootstrap fixture.

full_production_rebootstrap.detail: Bounded code-export verification used the frozen source result plus SHA-256, schema, count, and source-oracle checks. The shipped `python scripts/control_under_load.py all` command performs the complete 2,000-draw CPU rebootstrap and cell-by-cell comparison without rerunning the model.
